Messages.Author: xcver
Messages.Body:
Can Epikasta return only Action cards like Bum's Rush, Aranthebes, GtU
etc. to your library or any type of card that does an action as well
(Political Action, Retainer, Ally etc.)?

Name: Epikasta Rigatos
[KoT:PT2]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Toreador
Group: 4
Capacity: 8
Discipline: cel AUS DOM PRE
Camarilla Prince of New York: You may move an action card Epikasta plays
from your ash heap to your library at the end of the action (shuffle
afterward).

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Can Epikasta retrieve action cards she did not play in a normal
fashion?
We think she can't, but a confirmation is welcome :)

Examples :
- the KRC resulting of the CL action,
- a Saturday Night Special she concealed during the action (and that
burned due to Canine Horde or Dragon Breath Rounds)

Thanks.
